title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Drafts (R787-R804 Source-Repair Rollup)
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The July 7, 2026 version keeps the compact reader-first layout from the July 6 cleanup and adds organized source-repair/source-audit rollups for recent WebB packets R787-R804.

Open first: 00_Noether_German_Cumulative_Working_SourceControl_R796_20260705.pdf, 01_Noether_English_Cumulative_Working_Reader_RA10_20260612.pdf, and 02_Noether_Standalone_English_Papers_01_43_WorkingDrafts_20260706.zip. The new July 7 evidence is grouped as 06a, 06b, and 06c source-repair/audit ZIPs, with 06d as an auxiliary OCR-locator companion and CSV manifests/checksums.

New July 7 scope: R787-R789 cover Paper 30 source-critical/content-carry loci; R791 and R798 cover Paper 30 hard-math/merge-closure material; R792-R804 cover Paper 24, Paper 34, Paper 40, Paper 14, and Paper 19 source-repair/survival/closure packets. Local intake gaps are explicit: R790 and R799 had checksum sidecars but their matching ZIPs were not found in the swept Noether folder. Duplicate R795/R798 downloads were excluded.

Status: this is a serious source-repair and translation working corpus, not OCR-only, but it is not a critical edition and not a globally certified final Noether corpus. File names inside inherited packets may include COMPLETE; that word indicates that a web-session packet completed its local task, not that the Noether corpus or the relevant paper is certified complete. Dense formulas, tables, scan-difficult passages, and language branches still require source checking. The German/source-control branch remains the authority for downstream translations.

Older granular repair packets remain preserved in previous Zenodo versions. Corrections can be proposed through the GitHub mirror: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with added R787-R804 source-repair/audit rollups. Not a critical edition, not a global source-faithfulness certification, and not a complete multilingual synchronization.
